classes.title: ABSOLUTE CINEMA
classes.subtitle: Joanna Senyszyn - Both hands raised open at head height
classes.hint: Raise both hands open near head/shoulder height with elbows bent

classes.title: THINKING MONKEY
classes.subtitle: Thinking Monkey - One hand resting on chin, other arm relaxed
classes.hint: Place one hand on your chin while keeping the other arm relaxed down

classes.title: ELON SALUTE
classes.subtitle: Elon Musk - One arm stretched straight up and forward
classes.hint: Stretch one arm straight up and forward diagonally while keeping the other arm down

classes.title: KAMEHAMEHA
classes.subtitle: Goku - Both arms stretched forward in front next to each other
classes.hint: Stretch both arms forward in front of your torso with wrists next to each other

classes.title: TRADE OFFER
classes.subtitle: Trade Offer - Both hands pressed together in a praying posture
classes.hint: Bring both hands together in front of your chest like praying

classes.title: GAGRI GAGRI
classes.subtitle: Gagri Gagri - Scratching the top of your head with both hands
classes.hint: Place both hands right on the top of your head as if scratching it

classes.title: SPONGEBOB BICEPS
classes.subtitle: SpongeBob Flex - Flexing arm at 90 degrees to show biceps
classes.hint: Extend one arm out to the side and bend your elbow 90 degrees upward to show your bicep

classes.title: T-POSE DOMINANCE
classes.subtitle: Assert Dominance - Both arms stretched straight horizontally
classes.hint: Extend both arms straight out horizontally at shoulder level

classes.title: CHILL GUY
classes.subtitle: Just a Chill Guy - Relaxed posture with arms resting down
classes.hint: Stand in a relaxed posture with both arms resting down at your sides
